reason: Under the transfer/leakage lens the refined idea survives: no separate ef_anom variant, only a finals decision rule. I checked the three leakage channels on edges_exp39.parquet (scratchpad eftr.py / eftr.out). (1) In-sample edge network / ILP. On the anomalous transitions, which carry ~90-95% of ef's gain, the ILP-elsewhere condition barely matters. Drop precision without the condition (a0) vs with it (a3): 44b6 big-step 0.98 vs 0.98 (est_drop +0.00161 vs +0.00157, all-GT units); 6bba big-step 0.89 vs 0.92 (+0.00611 vs +0.00594); 6bba post-freeze 0.87 vs 0.94 (+0.00306 vs +0.00296). So the gain there comes from dropping relink edges between pairs the network never scored; that is geometric plus motion-model and GT-free, not in-sample trust. Only the re-link adds (~+0.0023 all-GT units) use the in-sample ILP. Where the ILP is load-bearing is the ORDINARY transitions: without the condition, drops have precision 0.45 and est -0.0007; with it, +0.0006. So 'ef gates itself on ordinary steps' is itself an in-sample property. But the worst-case out-of-sample swing is ~0.001-0.0015 per embryo, below LB resolution. That is also why ef_anom is not worth a slot. (2) Node multiplier: node ratio 0.99955 for ef_a3_rl_pr, so this is not the min-track-length artefact. (3) 44b6 crop redundancy: 44b6's gain is ~95% on big-step transitions, 57% of it in 5 of 71 overlapping crops of ONE recording, so the 44b6 confirmation is effectively a few events. 6bba is broad: 99/128 videos positive, top-10 videos hold 32%. Private transfer therefore depends on whether the hidden embryo(s) have fast, drift or freeze transitions. Both train recordings do: 6% and 23% of transitions flagged, 0% vs 7.2% frozen. FLAW (not fatal, but it changes how the policy reads a flat probe): the refined text's '44b6-like: ~+0.0015' is in all-GT units. Per embryo, 44b6 gains ~+0.012 (lab +0.0145) from only ~6% flagged transitions. So every train-like embryo gains +0.012..0.017. A flat public result (S29 < +0.003) then means one of two things: the public embryo is calmer than both train recordings (<~1% big-step transitions), or ef does not transfer, e.g. through the 5.5 vs 6.0 tight-gate difference, which bites exactly at big steps, or the out-of-sample detector. The idea treats flat as mostly 'calm public embryo'; it is at best ambiguous. Keeping ef in ONE of two best-of-2 finals is still a cheap hedge. Its harm is bounded: a0 on ordinary transitions is only -0.0007, and larger harm would show up as S29 <= -0.003, which the policy already treats as a drop signal.
fix_if_any: (a) Correct the arithmetic in the policy: per-embryo expected gain for any train-like embryo is +0.012..0.017 (44b6-like ~+0.012, not +0.0015). Treat a flat S29 as roughly 50/50 between 'calm public embryo' and 'non-transfer', not as mostly benign. (b) Tie the flat-case hedge to exp50 as well. If S30 (drop-only, ILP-independent) is also flat, the anomaly mechanism itself failed or the embryo is calm, and the hedge is justified only if no stronger candidate needs the slot. If S30 > S29 + 0.002, the in-sample re-link is the problem: hedge with drop-only ef_a0/ef_a3 instead of ef_a3_rl_pr. (c) Make the hedge final coordhead-based if exp51 beats exp48 (exp51 + ef, not exp48 + ef). Push that kernel before 29 Sep and check it runs validly, because ef has never been measured on float/refined coordinates. It is likely orthogonal: head shifts <= 2 um vs ef's 5.5-10 um relaxed-relink edges. (d) Optional, if the replay readout is run: report the a0 vs a3 split per class (as in eftr.out) and per-embryo deltas in per-embryo units, not all-GT units. Also run a leave-44b6-top-5-crops-out check to show the 44b6 gain is not one drift event.
realistic_public_gain: Directly from this idea: ~0 (no new variant; ef_anom = ef within 0.0006). Its value is in the finals decision: public effect is read from probe 29. Private: if ef transfers and the private embryo is train-like, +0.012..0.017 per embryo; if it is calm, ~+0.000..0.001; if ef does not transfer, the bounded harm on ordinary transitions is ~-0.001. Expected private value of keeping ef in one final after a flat public result: ~+0.003..0.006.
